motivation: repair v2 (mean hold_min/hold_max interval) fixed the dev misattribution (rule+cause 42/363 -> 354/363 below-band repairs) but failed on held-out T6 inits 30-49: averaged min/max intervals of a high-variance object (mug, per-episode spread 5.6 N) are judged outside every band, candidates are dropped, false stops 9-34. v3 replaces interval prediction by per-row band membership and never drops a v1-direction candidate on data.

repair_v3_member.candidates_C: same as v2: untried (f, s0), f != f0, closure stop lo <= band hi; for slip_or_drop also (f0, slower speed inside the speed band)
repair_v3_member.evidence: rows via Library._sel backoff (obj+cfg -> obj+force -> any_obj+cfg); k = rows meeting the full s25 pass criterion (task_ok, stable, whole hold window inside the force band, speed inside the speed band)
repair_v3_member.order: 1) S = candidates in C with k >= 1, by Library.p_pass posterior (existing Beta prior on rule_prior, strength 2) descending, ties by V1 order then FORCES index; 2) remaining V1 candidates in V1 order. Candidates in neither set are never tried

data.dev: T0/T1/T7 step25 grid and T6 inits 30-49 (v2 failure seen there)
data.held_out: fresh T6 grid on inits 0-29 (never used for manner), frozen program, same 10 forces x 3 speeds, evaluated once

adoption_rule: v3 adopted for a policy iff on held-out: pass >= v1 pass - 0.5 AND false stops <= v1 false stops + 1 AND failed attempts < v1 failed attempts; otherwise reported as not adopted
seeds_budget: 10 seeds, budget 3, same request stream generator as v1/v2
